title: Meta Pauses Employee-Tracking Program Following Internal Data Leak
summary: Meta has suspended its employee-tracking program after an internal data leak exposed sensitive information, raising serious privacy and security concerns within the company.
problem_solved: This article reports on a corporate security incident rather than describing a solution—highlighting the risks of internal surveillance programs.
why_valuable: It underscores the delicate balance between corporate security measures and employee privacy rights, serving as a cautionary tale for organizations implementing tracking systems.
